rationale: With only $21.75 remaining in the daily loss budget and AMD priced at $586.63, the minimum allowed position size of 0.5% ($500) cannot purchase a single whole share, and even a 1-share position with a logical structural invalidation below $584.98 or the 5-minute 9-EMA ($585.00) combined with the $0.19 spread would risk breaching the daily loss limit on routine noise. Because there is insufficient risk capital to accommodate normal intraday volatility (5m ATR is $2.70), skipping is required to preserve the remaining daily loss buffer.
